newsitem.title: USA: ABC to name entertainment chief - source.
newsitem.headline: ABC to name entertainment chief - source.

text.p: Walt Disney Co's ABC unit will name Stuart Bloomberg as the new chairman of its entertainment division, according to a source at ABC.
ABC will announce the appointment Tuesday, the source said.
Bloomberg, currently president of television creative services for ABC, will fill the position left vacant when Ted Harbert resigned from the post earlier this year.
ABC hired Jamie Tarses as president of ABC Entertainment last year from General Electric Co's NBC unit, where she was a top programming executive.

Some industry observers wondered whether the apppointment was an omen that Tarses was being edged out of her post. The ABC source said Bloomberg's appointment was not intended to oust Tarses, but to give the network some additional muscle on the financial side, especially in negotiating contracts with production companies. Neither Bloomberg nor Tarses could be reached immediately for comment.
Daily Variety reported the pending appointment Tuesday.
Bloomberg has nearly 20 years of TV experience, and has worked in West Coast programming, and has worked on overall program development, and a consultant on all parts of the broadcast day.
